==Notes==
* All [[action]]s (including skill activations, attacks, and movement) will be [[cancel]]ed when this form ends.
* The +30 Armor reduces incoming elemental damage by roughly 40%. 
* This form uses female [[ranger]] animations, regardless of your [[character]]'s gender or profession.
*The [[hero]] [[M.O.X.]] has a unique model for this form.
